title: Probabilistic acceptance language
statement: Given a padded machine coding, its probabilistic acceptance language consists of binary strings $y$ for which there exist binary strings $\alpha$ and $x$, and a natural number $t$, such that $y$ is the prescribed pair encoding of $\alpha$ and the pair encoding of $x$ followed by $t$ copies of $1$, and the machine decoded from $\alpha$ accepts $x$ within time $t$ with probability at least $2/3$.
